load_hand_model_from_json: load a hand model from a JSON file and return a HandModel object with tensor fields
load_default_hand_model: load the default generic hand model from the built-in JSON file for forward kinematics
forward_kinematics: convert batched joint angles to 3D landmark coordinates using forward kinematics
TorchHandModel: wrap a HandModel as an nn.Module for device transfers and automatic parameter management
broadcast_hand_model_to: broadcast a hand model along leading batch dimensions for batched forward kinematics calls
